Ui.Script:
-- Deviation: the stock FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished (FloatingChatFrame.lua:989-992) nils -- oldAlpha even under a live hover, so leaving and re-entering within -- CHAT_FRAME_FADE_TIME (a flick to the scroll buttons, outside the hover box, does it) -- stops the plate fading in (l.873) for the rest of the session; this keeps oldAlpha while -- hover is set. if FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished then function FCF_ChatTabFadeFinished(chatTab, chatFrame) chatTab:Hide() if not chatFrame.hover then chatFrame.oldAlpha = nil end end end
-- Deviation: re-runs UIParent_ManageFramePositions after DurabilityFrame's own OnEvent. The -- pass seats the frame 20 further in while a side glyph shows (UIParent.lua:1759-1768), -- but the stock frame runs it only from OnShow/OnHide, so a glyph appearing while the frame -- is shown leaves the shield's overhang off the screen edge. The stock handler runs first, -- unchanged, on the this/event/arg1 already set for the dispatch. if DurabilityFrame then local refOnEvent = DurabilityFrame:GetScript("OnEvent") DurabilityFrame:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if refOnEvent then refOnEvent() end UIParent_ManageFramePositions() end) end
-- Deviation: friendly plates the player turned on come back at every world entry. The -- stock UpdateNameplates (UIOptionsFrame.lua:768-780) shows them and hides them again at -- once (l.775-776), and FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON is never saved, since l.182 registers -- NAMEPLATES_ON a second time. function UpdateNameplates() if ( NAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowNameplates() else HideNameplates() end if ( FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON ) then ShowFriendNameplates() else HideFriendNameplates() end end RegisterForSave("FRIENDNAMEPLATES_ON")
-- Deviation (this fork): on a Turtle WoW realm the dungeon finder's eye offers the way -- out of the finder's dungeon and back in. Turtle's menu (LFT.lua:1773-1816) has no such -- row; the server of this fork ports a finder group in, says so with S2C_DUNGEON_RUN, -- and answers C2S_DUNGEON_TELEPORT. The row leads the eye's own menu, which the stock -- function builds after it, unchanged. No LFT.lua loads on a 1.12.1 realm, so nothing -- here runs there. if LFTActionsDropDown_Init then local refInit = LFTActionsDropDown_Init local inRun
local function Teleport(direction) SendAddonMessage(LFT_ADDON_PREFIX, "C2S_DUNGEON_TELEPORT" .. LFT_ADDON_FIELD_DELIMITER .. direction, LFT_ADDON_CHANNEL) end
function LFTActionsDropDown_Init() local ours if inRun and LFTActionsDropDown.owner == LFTMinimapButton and GetNumPartyMembers() + GetNumRaidMembers() > 0 then local info = {} info.notCheckable = 1 info.func = Teleport if IsInInstance() then info.text = "Teleport out of dungeon" info.arg1 = "out" else info.text = "Teleport to dungeon" info.arg1 = "in" end UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) ours = DropDownList1.numButtons end refInit() -- The stock menu closes with its own Cancel row when it has any row at all. if ours and DropDownList1.numButtons == ours then local info = {} info.notCheckable = 1 info.text = CANCEL info.func = HideDropDownMenu info.arg1 = 1 UIDropDownMenu_AddButton(info) end end
local watch = CreateFrame("Frame") watch:RegisterEvent("CHAT_MSG_ADDON") watch:SetScript("OnEvent", function() if arg1 == LFT_ADDON_PREFIX then local _, _, state = strfind(arg2, "^S2C_DUNGEON_RUN" .. LFT_ADDON_FIELD_DELIMITER .. "(%d)") if state then inRun = state == "1" end end end) end
-- Deviation: a button whose key moved away keeps the old key's label while it holds an -- action with no range (a stance, a self buff). The stock ActionButton_UpdateHotkeys -- (ActionButton.lua:129-140) writes no text in that one unbound case; this clears it. The -- stock function runs first, unchanged. local refUpdateHotkeys = ActionButton_UpdateHotkeys function ActionButton_UpdateHotkeys(actionButtonType) refUpdateHotkeys(actionButtonType) local action = (actionButtonType or "ACTIONBUTTON")..this:GetID() local button = ActionButton_GetPagedID(this) if ( GetBindingText(GetBindingKey(action), "KEY_", 1) == "" and HasAction(button) and not ActionHasRange(button) ) then getglobal(this:GetName().."HotKey"):SetText("") end end
-- wenilla carry: TurtleWoW's arena leftovers, defined only where that chain names them, so -- stock 1.12 gains no names (ported from benilla-octo 031acdd8, d729fc11, 3247bc76). -- -- Its `CharacterFrame.lua` appends "ArenaFrame" to `CHARACTERFRAME_SUBFRAMES`, six names -- where the reference has five, and no file on the chain defines the frame, so the tab -- loop's Hide indexes nil. An empty hidden page, id 6, continuing PaperDoll 1 .. Honor 5. if ( CHARACTERFRAME_SUBFRAMES and CHARACTERFRAME_SUBFRAMES[6] == "ArenaFrame" and not ArenaFrame and CharacterFrame ) then local page = CreateFrame("Frame", "ArenaFrame", CharacterFrame) page:SetAllPoints(CharacterFrame) page:SetID(6) page:Hide() end -- Its `WorldStateFrame.lua:217` calls `RequestArenaScoreInfo()` on the battleground score -- events; the function is native to its client and 1.12 has no arena scoreboard, so the -- request is a no-op. `RequestCustomScoreInfo`, its battleground twin, marks that chain. if ( RequestCustomScoreInfo and not RequestArenaScoreInfo ) then RequestArenaScoreInfo = function() end end
